authorization.scope: Run only the bounded authenticated Workana read-only local bridge and sanitized GitHub writeback benchmark.

experiment_contract.hypothesis: Windows Task Scheduler can launch the already-verified bounded local bridge once, without Kael manually starting the worker, and the worker can return a sanitized result to GitHub.
experiment_contract.metric: One-shot scheduler registration plus automatic task start plus authenticated read-only browser PASS plus sanitized GH_API writeback plus local scheduler cleanup verification.
experiment_contract.success: Remote challenge records scheduler-launched bridge PASS, no external side effects, zero spend, and cleanup harness verifies the scheduled task is absent afterward.
experiment_contract.failure: Task does not run, browser or writeback fails, recurring/persistent execution is created, cleanup cannot verify task removal, or any unauthorized side effect occurs.
experiment_contract.risk: A Windows scheduled task could remain configured or execute unexpectedly; mitigated by one-shot trigger, no recurrence, bounded worker, execution time limit, cleanup in finally, and explicit absence verification.

next_gate: Prepare deterministic scheduler worker, pre-created challenge, and one-shot registration/cleanup harness. Kael must execute the prepared setup command on the local PC; no recurring task or persistent service may be created.
authority_effect: BOUNDED_LOCAL_SYSTEM_AUTHORIZATION_ONLY. No business authority is expanded.
truth_limit: Authorization is not execution. Scheduler capability remains unverified until the remote challenge and cleanup evidence are observed.
